messages.author: MYRIAN TORRES RICO
messages.body:
Hi all,
I have a brief question about the amber method pmemd.cuda. Is Pmemd
connected with the Particle Mesh Ewald Method?
Thanks in advance,
Regards
Myriam

messages.author: Elvis Martis
messages.body:
HI
Yes, it is. pmemd stands for particle mesh Ewald molecular dynamics.
Best Regards
Elvis
